scoring_justification: Recompute ΔE from raw DFT total energies and classify magnetic ground state; the checker does not trust a self-reported classification.

hidden_assets.source_provenance: Derived from paper-reported qualitative magnetic trends and calculated spin moments (Table 1)
hidden_assets.generation_method: Thresholds set to match known physical behaviour: UFeAl/URuAl non-magnetic (delta_E>=-0.1 meV, moment<0.1 μB), UCoAl borderline (-5meV<=delta_E<=5meV, moment<0.5 μB), UNiAl/URhAl/UIrAl/UPtAl magnetic (delta_E<0, 0.3<=moment<=2.5 μB).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Thresholds are based on the paper's reported classification and moment ranges for scalar-relativistic LSDA, not arbitrary.

outputs.description: Raw total energies and spin magnetic moment from DFT-LSDA calculations; the checker recomputes ΔE = E_spin - E_nonmag and classifies the magnetic ground state.

output_contract.notes: Spin-orbit coupling, orbital polarization, and metamagnetic state search are excluded from this reproduction scope.

steps.description: Recompute ΔE from raw energies and classify magnetic ground state per compound
